content_sections.heading: Indian Army TES 57 Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Online registration for Indian Army TES 57 begins on 14 October 2026 at 12:00 noon. Candidates must complete the application by 12 November 2026 at 12:00 noon. The SSB interview process is tentatively scheduled for February–March 2027. The actual SSB interview dates, selection centre details and reporting instructions will be communicated through the Indian Army recruitment system.

content_sections.heading: Indian Army TES 57 Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The Indian Army has announced 90 provisional vacancies for the 10+2 Technical Entry Scheme - 57. Selected candidates will undergo engineering and military training before being considered for Permanent Commission in the Army. content_sections.heading: Indian Army TES 57 Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Indian Army TES 57 Recruitment 2026 must have passed Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics, secured at least 60% aggregate marks in these three subjects and appeared in JEE Main 2026. The entry is open to unmarried male candidates who satisfy the prescribed nationality, age and medical standards. Must have passed Class 12 or an equivalent examination from a recognized education board. Must have studied Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics (PCM). Must have secured a minimum aggregate of 60% marks in PCM. The PCM percentage is calculated using Class 12 marks in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics. Must have appeared in JEE Main 2026. Yes. Appearing in JEE Main 2026 is mandatory for TES-57. The Indian Army will shortlist eligible applicants using the JEE Main 2026 Common Rank List (CRL). Meeting the Class 12 PCM percentage requirement alone does not guarantee an SSB interview call. The 60% requirement applies to the aggregate marks obtained in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics in Class 12. Candidates must enter their actual PCM percentage up to two decimal places without rounding it off. The notification allows unmarried male candidates who satisfy the prescribed nationality requirements, including: Citizens of India. Subjects of Nepal. Eligible persons of Indian origin who migrated from the countries listed in the notification with the intention of permanently settling in India. Certain candidates require a Government of India eligibility certificate. The notification provides an exemption from this certificate requirement for Gorkha subjects of Nepal. The entry is restricted to unmarried male candidates. Selected candidates must undertake not to marry until they complete the training programme. A candidate who marries after applying will not be selected for training, even if successful in the selection process. Marriage during training can lead to discharge and recovery of the prescribed training expenditure.

content_sections.heading: Indian Army TES 57 Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit for Indian Army TES 57 Recruitment 2026 is 16 years 6 months to 19 years 6 months as on 1 July 2027. Candidates must have been born between 1 January 2008 and 1 January 2011, with both dates included. Age Proof: The date of birth recorded in the Matriculation or Class 10 certificate, or the accepted equivalent certificate, will be used. Changes to the recorded date of birth are not permitted.

content_sections.heading: Indian Army TES 57 Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection for Indian Army TES 57 begins with shortlisting based on JEE Main 2026 CRL, followed by the Services Selection Board (SSB) interview, medical examination and final merit list. The final merit list is based on SSB marks, subject to medical fitness, eligibility and vacancy availability. Application Shortlisting: The Indian Army will shortlist applicants based on JEE Main 2026 Common Rank List and the prescribed cut-off. SSB Interview: Shortlisted candidates will undergo a five-day SSB assessment. Medical Examination: Candidates recommended by the SSB will undergo a medical examination at a military hospital. Final Merit List: Merit will be prepared based on marks obtained in the SSB interview. Joining Letter: Medically fit candidates will receive joining instructions according to merit, eligibility and available vacancies. The TES-57 SSB interviews are tentatively expected between February and March 2027. The SSB assessment is conducted over five days and consists of two stages. Candidates who do not clear Stage I are sent back on the same day. The SSB assessment includes evaluation by psychologists, Group Testing Officers and Interviewing Officers. Selection centre allocation and interview instructions will be communicated to shortlisted candidates through the registered email address, SMS and official recruitment system. The TES-57 final merit list is prepared on the basis of SSB marks. Higher academic qualifications, previous performance and NCC background do not provide additional merit-list weightage. Final joining depends on medical fitness, the candidate's merit position, fulfillment of eligibility conditions and available vacancies.

content_sections.heading: Indian Army TES 57 Training Period 2027
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will undergo four years of integrated military and engineering training. The programme consists of three years at a Cadets Training Wing and one year at the Indian Military Academy, Dehradun. Candidates who successfully complete the four-year training programme will be awarded an Engineering degree. Candidates recommended by the SSB must submit preferences for all three Cadets Training Wings. Final allocation is decided by the Indian Army.

content_sections.heading: Indian Army TES 57 Salary and Training Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Indian Army TES-57 cadets receive a stipend of Rs. 56,100 per month during their training at the Indian Military Academy after completing the initial three years of training. On successful commissioning as a Lieutenant, they become eligible for the Level 10 pay scale of Rs. 56,100–1,77,500 and applicable allowances. The advertised annual CTC is an approximate figure and is not the same as guaranteed monthly take-home salary. Promotion to higher ranks is subject to the relevant service conditions and selection requirements.

content_sections.heading: Indian Army TES 57 Physical and Medical Standards
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the Indian Army's medical and physical fitness standards for officer entry. The notification also provides minimum physical fitness standards expected when reporting for training. These are the standards expected on arrival for training. Candidates should separately consult the official medical standards for the selection-stage medical examination.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Indian Army TES 57 Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must apply online through the official Indian Army recruitment portal between 14 October and 12 November 2026. The application window closes at 12:00 noon on the last date. Visit the official Indian Army recruitment website at https://joinindianarmy.nic.in/ . Open the online application section for 10+2 Technical Entry Scheme - 57. Read the TES-57 notification and application instructions carefully. Complete the online application with the required personal and educational details. Enter the correct date of birth as recorded in the accepted Class 10 certificate. Enter the actual Class 12 PCM aggregate percentage up to two decimal places without rounding off. Provide the required JEE Main 2026 application details. Review all entries and submit the application before the closing deadline. Retain the submitted application details for further recruitment stages. After the application window closes, download and print the system-generated application form as instructed. Important: Candidates should submit only one application. Multiple applications by the same candidate may result in cancellation of candidature.

content_sections.heading: Indian Army TES 57 Application Correction and Printout Instructions
content_sections.text: The Army permits candidates to correct application details before the online application window closes. After the final submission process, changes are not permitted under the notification's instructions. Check and correct all application entries before the deadline. Resubmit the application after making permitted changes. The application printout becomes available approximately 30 minutes after the application window closes. Print two copies of the application form carrying the system-generated roll number. Carry one self-attested copy to the SSB interview and retain the other for personal reference. Do not send a hard copy of the application to the Directorate General of Recruiting.

content_sections.heading: Indian Army TES 57 Documents Required for SSB Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates must carry the required documents for verification at the SSB interview. The notification specifies original certificates and self-attested photocopies. The original documents will be returned after verification at the SSB. Candidates must follow any additional instructions included in their SSB call-up letter.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in Indian Army TES 57 Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Indian Army has announced 90 provisional vacancies for the 10+2 Technical Entry Scheme - 57, with the course commencing in July 2027.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Indian Army TES 57 Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 12 November 2026, up to 12:00 noon.

faq.question: Q3. When does Indian Army TES 57 registration start?
faq.answer: The online registration window opens on 14 October 2026 at 12:00 noon.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for Indian Army TES 57?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics, secured at least 60% aggregate marks in PCM and appeared in JEE Main 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Is JEE Main compulsory for Indian Army TES 57 Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Appearance in JEE Main 2026 is mandatory. The Army uses the JEE Main 2026 Common Rank List for shortlisting.

faq.question: Q6. Can candidates with 60% PCM marks apply for TES 57?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates with at least 60% aggregate marks in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics in Class 12 can apply if they satisfy the JEE Main, age and other eligibility conditions.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for Indian Army TES 57?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 16 years 6 months and 19 years 6 months as on 1 July 2027. The eligible date-of-birth range is 1 January 2008 to 1 January 2011, both dates inclusive.

faq.question: Q8. Can female candidates apply for Indian Army TES 57?
faq.answer: No. The TES-57 notification invites applications from unmarried male candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for Indian Army TES 57?
faq.answer: Selection includes shortlisting based on JEE Main 2026 CRL, a five-day SSB interview, medical examination and final merit list. Joining is subject to eligibility and available vacancies.

faq.question: Q10. Is there a separate written examination for Indian Army TES 57?
faq.answer: The notification does not prescribe a separate recruitment written examination. Shortlisting is based on JEE Main 2026 CRL, followed by SSB and medical assessment.
